title: Lesson 15: Fifty Pence Worth of Trouble

segments.text: Did George get anything for his fifty pence? What?
segments.translation: 乔治用他的50便士换到了什么吗？是什么？

segments.text: Children always appreciate small gifts of money.
segments.translation: 孩子总喜欢得到一点零用钱。

segments.text: Mum or dad, of course, provides a regular supply of pocket money, but uncles and aunts are always a source of extra income.
segments.translation: 当然，爸爸妈妈会定期给孩子一些零用钱，但叔叔阿姨们总是额外收入的来源。

segments.text: With some children, small sums go a long way.
segments.translation: 对有些孩子来说，小钱也能花很久。

segments.text: If fifty pence pieces are not exchanged for sweets, they rattle for months inside money boxes.
segments.translation: 如果50便士的硬币不换成糖果，它们就会在储蓄罐里叮当响上好几个月。

segments.text: Only very thrifty children manage to fill up a money box.
segments.translation: 只有非常节俭的孩子才能把储蓄罐填满。

segments.text: For most of them, fifty pence is a small price to pay for a nice big bar of chocolate.
segments.translation: 对大多数孩子来说，50便士只是买一大块巧克力所付出的很小代价。

segments.text: My nephew, George, has a money box but it is always empty.
segments.translation: 我的外甥乔治有一个储蓄罐，但它总是空的。

segments.text: Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I have given him have found their way there.
segments.translation: 我给他那些50便士的硬币和1英镑的硬币，很少有进入那个储蓄罐的。

segments.text: I gave him fifty pence yesterday and advised him to save it.
segments.translation: 昨天我给了他50便士，并建议他把它存起来。

segments.text: Instead, he bought himself fifty pence worth of trouble.
segments.translation: 结果，他给自己买回了50便士的麻烦。

segments.text: On his way to the sweet shop, he dropped his fifty pence and it bounced along the pavement and then disappeared down a drain.
segments.translation: 在去糖果店的路上，他把50便士掉在了地上，硬币在人行道上弹跳了几下，掉进下水道里不见了。

segments.text: George took off his jacket, rolled up his sleeves and pushed his right arm through the drain cover.
segments.translation: 乔治脱掉外套，卷起袖子，把右胳膊伸进了下水道井盖的孔里。

segments.text: He could not find his 50 pence piece anywhere, and what is more, he could not get his arm out.
segments.translation: 他到处也找不到那枚50便士的硬币，更糟糕的是，他的胳膊拔不出来了。

segments.text: A crowd of people gathered round him and a lady rubbed his arm with soap and butter, but George was firmly stuck.
segments.translation: 一群人聚集在他周围，一位女士用肥皂和黄油涂抹他的胳膊，但乔治还是死死地卡在那儿。

segments.text: The fire brigade was called and two fire fighters freed George using a special type of grease.
segments.translation: 消防队被叫来了，两名消防员用一种特殊的润滑脂救出了乔治。

segments.text: George was not too upset by his experience because the lady who owns the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with a large box of chocolates.
segments.translation: 乔治对这次经历并不太难过，因为糖果店的老板娘听说了他的遭遇，奖励了他一大盒巧克力。
